summary: Careful protocol; core finding (shrinkage toward own scores fixes per-building under-coverage under random splits) holds. Robustness/generalisation evidence is weaker than claimed: (1) LOBO-tuned HSC-CQR is beaten by the untuned fixed-kappa variant in every stress/site/country condition, results exist in the repo but are omitted from Tables 6-7; (2) tuning is unstable for small calibration pools; (3) stress tests are mild or favour self-calibration; (4) 'from the first days' and other-alpha claims are untested for the headline method.

issues.title: Fixed kappa=168 beats LOBO-selected kappa in every robustness/generalisation setting; not reported
issues.evidence: raw_results has 'HSC-CQR fixed-κ' for exp=='robust' but Table 6 omits it. Under-covered share HSC-CQR vs fixed-κ: calpool10 7.9 vs 2.2; shift+40 6.5 vs 2.8; missing40 5.4 vs 2.6; noise15 1.7 vs 0.5; weak forecaster 5.4 vs 3.3. Table 7: LSO 5.3 vs 1.7 (MACD 0.020 vs 0.016); UCI->BDG2 8.7 vs 4.3 (0.023 vs 0.019); BDG2->BDG2 2.9 vs 1.6.
issues.action: Add fixed-κ to Tables 6-7; recommend a fixed or coverage-targeted kappa or justify IS-based LOBO; state the tuning objective works against reliability under shift.
issues.experiment: LOBO with coverage-aware objective (MACD, or IS s.t. under-coverage<=5%) in all settings of Tables 6-7.

issues.title: Kappa tuning unstable for small calibration pools
issues.evidence: run_info robust_BDG2_s*_cal10: hsc_cqr kappa = 168, 96, 1344; seed 2 (kappa=1344) leaves 19.0% under-covered vs Self-CQR 8.3%, fixed-κ 2.4%; text reports mean 7.9% only.
issues.action: Report per-seed results and selected kappa; add fallback rule (cap kappa or fixed kappa for small pools).
issues.experiment: Pools of 3,5,10,16,30 with 10+ resamples; joint small-training+small-calibration condition.

issues.title: Stress tests mild or favour self-calibration
issues.evidence: src/experiments.py:151-178: (a) i.i.d. homoscedastic noise added to evaluated truth too; Self-CQR beats HSC-CQR (noise15 0.1% vs 1.7%; MACD 0.010 vs 0.018), unmentioned. (b) hourly MCAR missingness. (c) single multiplicative step at day 28 absorbed by 7-day scale (coverage after week 1 drops only 0.892->0.881/0.884). Calibration/training data never perturbed.
issues.action: Weaken robustness claims; report post-change (days 29-56) coverage separately.
issues.experiment: Contiguous 1-7 day outages incl. week 1; variance/schedule changes; early shifts (day 3-7); holiday dips; history-only noise with clean truth; perturbed calibration buildings.

issues.title: Generalisation site-dependent; similarity prior hurts at unseen sites
issues.evidence: LSO one training run per fold. Per site HSC-CQR: Wolf 30.6% under-covered (11/36), Robin 13.6%; HSC-CQR simple 11.1%/9.1%; fixed-κ and QShrink-CQR 0%/0%. CQR fold s.d. ±17.6 pp. Rat fold = 248 buildings (~30%).
issues.action: Per-site table; state kNN localisation can harm; multiple training seeds per fold.
issues.experiment: Leave-one-site-out (10 folds) x 3 seeds with site-cluster bootstrap CIs.

issues.title: 'From the first days' not supported per building
issues.evidence: Share with week-1 coverage <0.80: random BDG2 HSC-CQR 10.5% vs CQR 11.8%; LSO 13.4% vs 15.3%; UCI->BDG2 18.3% vs 22.7%; HSC-CQR week-1 mean coverage UCI->BDG2 0.862.
issues.action: Report per-building week-1 under-coverage in Tables 2,3,7 with binomial/autocorrelation floor; qualify abstract/intro.
issues.experiment: Conservative first-week inflation (stage-matched upper prior quantile).

issues.title: No long-run drift test (56 days, no recency weighting)
issues.evidence: All protocols stop at h=56; Eq. (5) never discards old scores; Limitation 6.
issues.action: Extend window or restrict claims to first 8 weeks.
issues.experiment: Follow BDG2 targets 180-365 days with monthly coverage; HSC-CQR with/without forgetting vs ACI-CQR.

issues.title: Robustness on one dataset, 3 seeds, no inference
issues.evidence: Table 6 BDG2 only, no CIs/tests; QShrink-CQR sometimes beats HSC-CQR (calpool10 5.9 vs 7.9; missing20 3.4 vs 4.0; weak 3.7 vs 5.4) yet text says shrinkage degrades 'least'.
issues.action: Paired tests/bootstrap CIs; avoid rankings within noise.

issues.title: Headline method untested at other alpha
issues.evidence: T_alpha* tables have no HSC-CQR/QShrink/ACI-CQR/TQA/GHCP; absolute HSC does not beat Self-CP (BDG2 95%: MACD 0.019 vs 0.017; 80%: 0.039 vs 0.038).
issues.action: Run CQR family at 80%/95% or restrict claims to 90%.
issues.experiment: Main protocol, CQR family, alpha 0.05/0.2, both datasets.

issues.title: 'Weak forecaster' not weak
issues.evidence: 10% of training buildings = 128k rows, full features; CQR MACD 0.038->0.052; HSC never applied to seasonal-naive or pretrained scores.
issues.action: Qualify 'on top of any interval forecaster'.
issues.experiment: HSC on Naive+SCP, no-history-feature model, one small zero-shot pretrained forecaster.
